row.team_price_text: Create: $79/mo flat (annual billing), up to 10 team members
row.evidence: Instapage's plans page lists Enterprise SSO only on the custom-priced Convert plan, and its help centre, API reference and Okta listing (SWA only) document no SCIM or IdP provisioning.
row.notes: No SCIM found by absence: help-centre search for scim and provisioning returns nothing, the public API reference has no SCIM endpoints, and the Okta OIN app is SWA only. SAML SSO (Okta, Entra/Azure, PingOne, OneLogin, Google) is on Convert (Contact Sales). Plans are flat per account, not per user: Create $79/mo and Optimize $159/mo on annual billing, each with 10 team members; Convert is custom. Google sign-in on all plans is social sign-in, not SAML. The public REST API (personal bearer token, all paid plans, 5,000/10,000 calls per day) can list, bulk-invite, change roles of and remove workspace team members.

plans.name: Create
plans.price_text: $79 per month (annual billing), 15,000 unique monthly visitors, 10 team members
plans.notes: Flat per-account price. Google sign-in only (social, not SAML). The Annual toggle is active by default on the plans page.

plans.name: Optimize
plans.price_text: $159 per month (annual billing), 30,000 unique monthly visitors, 10 team members

plans.name: Convert
plans.notes: Enterprise SSO (SAML 2.0) and audit logs listed here; custom team-member count.

limitations.text: No SCIM endpoint or IdP provisioning is documented; team members are invited and removed by the account owner in Workspace settings > Team members or through the public API.

auth.notes: Personal API token per user, inheriting the creator's workspace role; no scopes. Team members need the Developer Access flag.

capabilities.notes: delete_user = remove a team member from a workspace (bulk). Roles are viewer, editor, manager. 'Groups' in the API are page folders, not user groups.

endpoints.purpose: List team members of a workspace
Bulk-invite team members with access levels
Remove one or more team members from a workspace

audit_log_api.notes: An in-app audit log exists (account owner only, some plans); no audit-log API endpoint was found in the API reference.

rate_limits.text: 200 requests per minute per token and IP, plus a daily plan quota (5,000/day Create, 10,000/day Optimize, custom Convert); 429 when exceeded.

okta.notes: The OIN page's capability list (rendered DOM) marks only SWA checked; SAML, SCIM and provisioning are unchecked. Instapage's own help says SAML with Okta is set up on Convert.
